description.en: Lightweight memory plugin for DSH: four Markdown files (USER/PROJECT/WORKLOG/CONVENTION) plus append/distill actions, zero external parts, prefix-cache-friendly dual-layer injection.
description.zh: 轻量记忆系统插件：四个 Markdown 文件（USER/PROJECT/WORKLOG/CONVENTION）+ append/distill 两个动作，零外部部件，prefix-cache 友好的双层注入。
